title: jaxgsa: Global Sensitivity Analysis in JAX
description: jaxgsa computes global sensitivity indices entirely in JAX. It provides thirteen methods, covering variance-based indices (Sobol, eFAST, Kucherenko), screening (Morris, DGSM), moment-independent and given-data measures (Borgonovo delta, PAWN, HSIC, optimal transport), and surrogate-based analysis (PCE, RS-HDMR, Shapley effects, VKOGA). Eleven of the thirteen methods export a traceable core that runs under jit, vmap and grad, on CPU, GPU or TPU. Kucherenko and VKOGA are host NumPy and SciPy by design.
